answer.rationale: Current situation shows simultaneous drops in activation (6% QoQ) and onboarding completion (4% QoQ). The durable memory indicates both signup simplification (memory_31) and onboarding shortening (memory_86) have driven measurable improvements in activation and completion. These two interventions are most directly causal to the observed declines. Verification of memory_31 and memory_86 will confirm effect sizes and implementation details to inform this week's single experiment slot. Simplify_onboarding addresses the root metric degradation and aligns with long-term qualified revenue (accounts that complete onboarding show better LTV). While competitive pricing pressure is real, memory_73 shows promotional pricing is effective for acquisition but doesn't directly address the activation/completion decline—it may also invite a race to the bottom. Referral incentives (memory_57) work best on established customers, not acutely on new signup flows. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) is high-value but orthogonal to the current SMB activation decline. Simplify_onboarding tackles both failing metrics simultaneously with proven precedent and preserves the option to run pricing experiments in subsequent weeks if activation remains depressed.
